name: cutcraft
description: The complete AI video-editing skill: from raw footage and creative direction to one verified final film.

interface.shortDescription: The full AI editing workflow—from footage to final.
interface.longDescription: CutCraft is the production-grade editing skill for people who need more than a transcript, caption file, or rough cut. It inspects footage, asks for all creative choices once with visual previews, makes a reproducible edit, finishes sound and picture, verifies the render, and preserves every revision path—without a browser editor or a folder full of mystery exports.
capabilities: Captions, transitions, effects, music and SFX
Render quality control and asset provenance
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $cutcraft:cutcraft to inspect my footage, show every creative choice once with visual previews, then create, verify, and deliver one clearly named final video with an editable revision path.
